with.goal: Present the substitution case to the human reviewer and return exactly one bare value based on their decision: gate_a_approved, gate_a_needs_revision, or gate_a_rejected. Do not include any explanation.

gate_b_approval.description: Gate B — Final Procurement Approval. Pauses execution after external engineer approval and presents the confirmed candidate, approval evidence, updated cost and schedule, and all deliverable URLs. Human selects approved (authorise final purchase and permanent model updates) or rejected (stop). No irreversible action occurs before this gate.

tasks.name: extract_specifications
tasks.description: Review all project specification files for {equipment_tag}. Extract: (1) hard technical requirements with zero tolerance, (2) negotiable requirements with acceptable ranges, (3) required certifications and listing requirements, (4) required-on-site date references, (5) approval procedures. For every requirement include: source_file, page_or_sheet, source_location, confidence (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), evidence_grade (CONFIRMED/INFERRED/MISSING). Apply skill: spec-requirement-extraction.
tasks.expected_output: A structured JSON object with arrays: hard_requirements, negotiable_requirements, required_certifications, approval_rules \\ each item containing requirement, source_file, page_or_sheet, source_location, confidence, evidence_grade.

tasks.name: extract_drawing_evidence
tasks.description: Review all project drawing files and original submittal files for {equipment_tag}. Extract: (1) envelope dimensions (H x W x D), (2) connector types, sizes, positions, and directions, (3) mounting point locations and requirements, (4) clearance zones (maintenance, installation access, code-required), (5) installation location coordinate or room reference. Tag every dimension with its source sheet and detail reference. Installation-critical dimensions must not be inferred \\ mark as MISSING if not found. Apply skill: evidence-provenance.
tasks.expected_output: A structured JSON object with: envelope_dimensions, connectors (array with type, size, position, direction, source), mounting_points, clearance_zones, installation_location, geometry_constraints, evidence_ledger \\ all with confidence and evidence_grade fields.

tasks.name: extract_schedule_impact
tasks.description: Review all equipment schedule files for {equipment_tag}. Calculate: (1) required-on-site date with source evidence, (2) affected predecessor and successor activities, (3) available float before critical path is impacted, (4) latest acceptable delivery date, (5) downstream commissioning and testing milestones affected by delay.
tasks.expected_output: A structured JSON object with: required_on_site_date, available_float_days, affected_downstream_activities (array), critical_path_impact, latest_acceptable_delivery_date, scheduling_evidence_ledger.

tasks.name: extract_contract_approval_rules
tasks.description: Review all original submittal files and specification Division 01 sections for {equipment_tag}. Extract: (1) substitution approval authority and process, (2) required documentation for substitution submission, (3) cost-responsibility clauses for delays and design changes, (4) RFI requirements, (5) any pre-approved substitution lists. Compile a full evidence ledger referencing every clause location. Apply skill: procurement-approval-policy.
tasks.expected_output: A structured JSON object with: approval_rules (array), cost_responsibility_rules (array), required_submission_documents (array), rfi_requirements, evidence_ledger \\ all with source_file, clause_reference, confidence, evidence_grade.

You apply the skill spec-requirement-extraction to identify hard requirements, negotiable tolerances, certification mandates, and approval procedures. You never invent or infer a requirement \\ if it is not explicitly stated in the documents, you mark it as unresolved with evidence_grade: MISSING.

You identify dimensional envelopes, connection point positions and sizes, clearance zones, and installation access paths. You apply the skill evidence-provenance to tag every finding with its source sheet, detail reference, and confidence level. Installation-critical dimensions are never inferred.

contract_approval_analyst.goal: Extract all contract terms, approval rules, substitution procedures, and cost-responsibility clauses relevant to replacing {equipment_tag} from original submittal files.
contract_approval_analyst.backstory: You are a construction contracts analyst who reads subcontracts, general conditions, specification Division 01, and approved submittals. You identify who must approve substitutions, what documentation is required, and which party bears costs for design changes or delays. You apply the skill procurement-approval-policy to flag non-compliant substitution routes.

project_evidence_crew.description: Multi-agent crew that extracts all technical, geometric, contractual, and scheduling requirements from project files. Agents: Specification Engineer, Drawing Evidence Analyst, Schedule Impact Analyst, Contract and Approval Analyst. tasks.name: scout_alternatives_nc
tasks.description: Search for alternative products to replace {equipment_tag} (original: {original_product}). Non-critical evidence gaps exist — proceed but flag affected requirements as UNCERTAIN. Use supplier catalogues, distributor databases, manufacturer websites, Gmail, and Google Drive. Identify at least 5 candidates. For each candidate record: manufacturer name, exact model number, source of model number verification, known technical specifications. Flag all unverified data as UNVERIFIED.
tasks.expected_output: A JSON array of candidate objects, each with: candidate_id, manufacturer, model_number, model_number_source, known_specs (object), data_verification_status (VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED), noncritical_uncertainty_flags (array of strings)

tasks.name: verify_inventory_nc
tasks.description: For each candidate identified by the Product Scout, verify: (1) exact inventory quantity available, (2) ship-from warehouse location, (3) earliest delivery date to project site. Contact suppliers via Gmail if needed. Record verification_timestamp for every data point. Mark each field UNVERIFIED if not confirmed by official source.
tasks.expected_output: A JSON array of candidates with added fields: inventory_qty, inventory_verified (boolean), inventory_timestamp, ship_from_location, earliest_delivery_date, delivery_verified (boolean), rfq_required (boolean).

tasks.name: normalize_quotes_nc
tasks.description: For each candidate, collect supplier quotes from {supplier_quote_summary} and Gmail. Normalize: product cost, freight cost, expediting options, quote validity date, payment terms, accessory inclusions, and warranty. Apply skill: quote-leveling. Record any quote field that cannot be confirmed as UNVERIFIED.
tasks.expected_output: A JSON array of candidates with added fields: product_cost, freight_cost, quote_validity, payment_terms, accessories_included, warranty_period, commercial_conditions, quote_verified (boolean).

tasks.name: technical_pre_filter_nc
tasks.description: Apply skill equipment-equivalence-review to assess each candidate against the hard requirements from the project evidence crew: {evidence_summary}. Note that some non-critical evidence items are marked UNCERTAIN — evaluate hard requirements only on confirmed evidence. Assign a pre_filter_verdict: technically_viable, hard_requirement_failed, or missing_product_evidence. Select the top 3 technically_viable candidates.
tasks.expected_output: A JSON object with: final_candidates (top 3 technically_viable), rejected_candidates (hard_requirement_failed with reasons), rfq_required_candidates (missing_product_evidence), noncritical_gaps_noted (array).

product_scout.goal: Find alternative products for {equipment_tag} that meet all hard technical requirements, verify exact manufacturer and model numbers, and apply skill quote-leveling to ensure comparisons are valid.
product_scout.backstory: You are a senior MEP procurement specialist with deep knowledge of equipment manufacturers, distributors, and approved vendor lists. You search supplier catalogues, distributor databases, and manufacturer websites to identify technically viable alternatives. You apply the skill quote-leveling to normalize product comparisons. You never invent model numbers or availability. Every model number must be verified from an official manufacturer source. Unverified data is always flagged as UNVERIFIED.

quote_normalization_agent.goal: Collect, normalize, and level all supplier quotes for the three candidate products applying skill quote-leveling to ensure commercial comparisons are valid.
quote_normalization_agent.backstory: You are a construction estimator and procurement analyst who normalizes supplier quotes by aligning scope, freight terms, validity periods, payment conditions, and accessory inclusions. You apply the skill quote-leveling to produce a standardized comparison table. You flag any quote field that cannot be confirmed as UNVERIFIED.

technical_pre_filter_agent.goal: Apply skill equipment-equivalence-review to assess each candidate against extracted hard requirements, and assign a pre-filter verdict: technically_viable, hard_requirement_failed, or missing_product_evidence.
technical_pre_filter_agent.backstory: You are a technical reviewer who applies the skill equipment-equivalence-review to compare each candidate product against the project hard requirements extracted by the Specification Engineer. You check ratings, certifications, physical envelope, connector compatibility, and any other hard constraints. You return a structured verdict for each candidate with detailed evidence references. A candidate fails if any hard requirement is not met by documented evidence. You never give the benefit of the doubt.

inventory_verification_agent.goal: Verify exact inventory quantities, ship-from locations, and earliest delivery dates for each candidate product using official supplier sources or timestamped communications.
inventory_verification_agent.backstory: You are a supply chain analyst who contacts suppliers and distributors to verify real-time inventory. You record the verification timestamp, ship-from warehouse location, and earliest delivery date for each unit. You mark all data as UNVERIFIED until confirmed by an official supplier source, quote, API response, or timestamped email. You never estimate or extrapolate availability.

supplier_intelligence_crew_noncritical.description: Multi-agent supplier intelligence crew that runs when non-critical evidence gaps exist. Proceeds with uncertainty flags on non-critical items. Same pipeline as the main supplier intelligence crew but marks non-critical gaps as UNCERTAIN throughout.

description: BuildCrew turns a delayed construction equipment order into an evidence-backed, install-ready BIM replacement. It automates disruption intake, project evidence extraction, supplier intelligence, BIM generation, coordination validation, commercial analysis, approval gating, and procurement execution — covering the full workflow normally performed by procurement, project engineering, BIM/VDC, estimating, scheduling, and project management.
